statements.expectationsWithoutRuntimeOutput: All expected labels were authored from the documented semantic contract only, before any resolver execution against Blind #5.
statements.noImplementationInternals: Production implementation internals (verb families, scoring weights, keyword lists, special-case regexes, routing tables) were not used to derive expected labels.
statements.authoringMethod: Manual expectations-first authoring: 60 novel prompts with contract-derived expected intent, constraints, primary, advisors, and CLEAR/AMBIGUOUS confidence. No resolver invocation, no behavior probing, no known-dataset wording reuse.
statements.immutability: After manifest creation the Blind #5 dataset is immutable: no expectation changes, no reruns, no relabeling of historical metrics.
